description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing of Git operations such as read-tree and status. It sets up a Git repository, configures sparse checkout, and runs performance tests on repository data to analyze algorithmic costs related to index operations and recursive tree traversal.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Sets up a default repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that is expected to succeed, with setup commands and assertions.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with specified description and commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
